from src.matrix import transpose, identity, matmul

# Test all functions thoroughly
print("Testing matrix operations...")

# Test 1: Transpose square matrix
result = transpose([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
expected = [[1, 3], [2, 4]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 1 passed")

# Test 2: Transpose wide matrix
result = transpose([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])
expected = [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 2 passed")

# Test 3: Transpose tall matrix
result = transpose([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]])
expected = [[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 3 passed")

# Test 4: Identity matrix
result = identity(3)
expected = [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 4 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 4 passed")

# Test 5: Matrix multiplication with identity
result = matmul([[1, 2], [3, 4]], identity(2))
expected = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 5 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 5 passed")

# Additional test: Matrix multiplication with identity (left side)
result = matmul(identity(2), [[1, 2], [3, 4]])
expected = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 6 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 6 passed")

# Additional test: Matrix multiplication non-identity
a = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
b = [[5, 6], [7, 8]]
result = matmul(a, b)
expected = [[19, 22], [43, 50]]
assert result == expected, f"Test 7 failed: {result} != {expected}"
print("✓ Test 7 passed")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
EOF
